command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$probe=Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ("hc-candidate-smoke-"+$env:GITHUB_RUN_ID+".py")
@'
import ctypes as c
from ctypes import wintypes as w
import subprocess,sys,time,tempfile,os,shutil
from pathlib import Path
from pywinauto import Desktop,keyboard
class HC(c.Structure):_fields_=(("cbSize",w.UINT),("dwFlags",w.DWORD),("lpszDefaultScheme",w.LPWSTR))
u=c.WinDLL("user32",use_last_error=True)
def hc():
    x=HC();x.cbSize=c.sizeof(x);assert u.SystemParametersInfoW(0x0042,x.cbSize,c.byref(x),0);return bool(x.dwFlags&1)
def until(fn,label,seconds=30):
    end=time.monotonic()+seconds
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        try:
            v=fn()
            if v:return v
        except Exception:pass
        time.sleep(.25)
    raise AssertionError(label)
def settings():
    ws=[x for x in Desktop(backend="uia").windows() if x.window_text() in ("설정","Settings")]
    return ws[-1] if ws else None
def close_settings():
    for x in Desktop(backend="uia").windows():
        if x.window_text() in ("설정","Settings"):
            try:x.close()
            except Exception:pass
    time.sleep(1)
def named_list(*names):
    win=settings()
    if win is None:return None
    names=set(names)
    return next((e for e in win.descendants(control_type="ListItem") if (e.window_text() or "").strip() in names),None)
def controls():
    win=settings()
    if win is None:return None
    combo=next((e for e in win.descendants(control_type="ComboBox") if e.is_visible()),None)
    apply=next((e for e in win.descendants(control_type="Button") if e.element_info.automation_id=="HighContrastThemeApplyButton"),None)
    return (combo,apply) if combo is not None and apply is not None else None
def set_hc(on):
    if hc()==on:return
    close_settings();subprocess.Popen(["cmd","/c","start","","ms-settings:"])
    until(settings,"Settings missing")
    until(lambda:named_list("접근성","Accessibility"),"Accessibility nav missing").click_input()
    card=until(lambda:named_list("대비 테마","Contrast themes"),"Contrast card missing")
    card.set_focus();keyboard.send_keys("{ENTER}")
    combo,apply=until(controls,"Contrast controls missing")
    try:
        try:combo.select("밤하늘" if on else "없음")
        except Exception:
            combo.click_input();keyboard.send_keys("{END}{ENTER}" if on else "{HOME}{ENTER}")
        apply.click_input();until(lambda:hc()==on,"Contrast target not reached")
    finally:close_settings()
exe=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
original=hc();proc=None;owned=None
print("HC_CANDIDATE_SMOKE_ORIGINAL",original,flush=True)
try:
    set_hc(True)
    owned=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="hc-candidate-smoke-"))
    folder=owned/"source";folder.mkdir()
    (folder/"contrast.txt").write_text("x",encoding="utf-8")
    env=os.environ.copy()
    for key in ("APPDATA","LOCALAPPDATA","TEMP","TMP"):
        d=owned/key.lower();d.mkdir();env[key]=str(d)
    proc=subprocess.Popen([str(exe),str(folder)],cwd=exe.parent,env=env)
    def ready():
        if proc.poll() is not None:return False
        ws=[x for x in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(process=proc.pid) if "flyExplorer" in x.window_text()]
        return ws[0] if ws else None
    win=until(ready,"candidate window missing",30)
    print("HC_CANDIDATE_WINDOW",repr(win.window_text()),hex(win.handle),flush=True)
    print("HC_CANDIDATE_SMOKE_PASS",True,flush=True)
finally:
    if proc and proc.poll() is None:
        try:proc.terminate();proc.wait(timeout=5)
        except Exception:pass
    if owned and owned.exists():shutil.rmtree(owned,ignore_errors=True)
    if hc()!=original:set_hc(original)
    print("HC_CANDIDATE_SMOKE_FINAL",hc(),flush=True)

'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $probe -Encoding UTF8
& python -X utf8 -m py_compile $probe
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "candidate smoke helper syntax failed"}
git fetch origin work/high-contrast-acceptance --no-tags --prune
git checkout -B work/high-contrast-acceptance origin/work/high-contrast-acceptance
$exe=Join-Path (Get-Location) "out\winui\Release\flyExplorer.exe"
if(-not(Test-Path $exe)){throw "candidate Release exe missing"}
& python -X utf8 $probe $exe
$code=$LASTEXITCODE
Remove-Item $probe -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if($code -ne 0){throw "candidate High Contrast launch smoke failed"}
Write-Host "HIGH_CONTRAST_CANDIDATE_LAUNCH_SMOKE_PASS"
